items.question: How is the prastara measured relative to the vedikā and tripāda portions?
premises: prastara is determined by tripāda part
the clause states a prescriptive relation
items.inference: the prastara would be reckoned by the tripāda portion taken from the vedikā portion
uncertainties: exact architectural referent of prastara remains context-dependent
items.plain_english: The prastara would be (measured) by the tripāda portion from the vedikā portion.
